title.full: Who can get a death certificate

summary.text: Non-next-of-kin cannot download it unless authorised by the deceased’s next-of-kin.

details.heading: Who can download it
details.body: Only the deceased’s next-of-kin, or someone authorised by them, can download the digital death certificate.

details.heading: If there is no next-of-kin
details.body: Someone helping with post-death matters can approach the hospital or certifying doctor for a hardcopy printout.

example_phrasings: Can a non-next-of-kin download the digital death certificate?
Who can get a death certificate for someone with no family?
Can a social worker or funeral director get the certificate?

sources.page_title: Can non next-of-kins (e.g. social service practitioners, godchildren, funeral directors) download the digital death certificate for a deceased person with no next-of-kin (e.g. single elderly)?

quotes.text: Only Next-of-Kin of the deceased or persons authorised by the Next-of-Kin are allowed to download a copy of the digital death certificate from My Legacy.
For deceased with no immediate Next-of-Kin, individuals who are assisting in the post-death matters can approach the hospital or certifying doctor for a hardcopy printout of the death certificate.
